car.name: RTG-S
car.description: A 182 hp, naturally aspirated AWD hatchback based on the US-market 2024 Impreza RS (introduced in 2023). Stock all-season tires. RTG-001 artwork is temporary. CVT represented by its eight published manual-mode ratios; unreported chassis parameters are estimates.

estimated: full torque curve outside published peaks
source.transmissionLimitation: Existing stepped automatic simulates the eight published CVT manual-mode ratios; not a continuously variable pulley model.
